title: .pre-commit-hooks.yaml
description: The hook manifest for prek, a git hook manager written in Rust.

entry.description: The command to run. It can contain arguments that will not be overridden.

language.description: The language of the hook. Tells prek how to install and run the hook.

alias.description: Not documented in the official docs.

files.description: The pattern of files to run on.

exclude.description:
Exclude files that were matched by `files`.
Default is `$^`, which matches nothing.

types.description:
List of file types to run on (AND).
Default is `[file]`, which matches all files.

types_or.description:
List of file types to run on (OR).
Default is `[]`.

exclude_types.description:
List of file types to exclude.
Default is `[]`.

additional_dependencies.description: Not documented in the official docs.

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the hook.

env.description: Environment variables to set while preparing and running the hook.

always_run.description:
This hook will run even if there are no matching files.
Default is false.

fail_fast.description:
If this hook fails, don't run any more hooks.
Default is false.

pass_filenames.description:
Append filenames that would be checked to the hook entry as arguments.
Default is true.

language_version.description:
Select a language version and optionally configure the toolchain source preference.
Default is `default`.
See <https://pre-commit.com/#overriding-language-version>.

log_file.description: Write the output of the hook to a file when the hook fails or verbose is enabled.

shell.description: Run the hook entry through a predefined shell adapter.

require_serial.description:
This hook will execute using a single process instead of in parallel.
Default is false.

stages.description:
Select which Git hook stages this hook runs for.
Default all stages are selected.
See <https://pre-commit.com/#confining-hooks-to-run-at-certain-stages>.

verbose.description:
Print the output of the hook even if it passes.
Default is false.

minimum_prek_version.description: The minimum version of prek required to run this hook.

FilePattern.description: A file pattern, either a regex or glob pattern(s).

PassFilenames.description: Whether to pass filenames to the hook. `true` passes all matching filenames (default), `false` passes none, and a positive integer limits each invocation to at most that many filenames.

request.description: A language-specific version request. Defaults to `default`.

preference.description: Which toolchain sources to prefer or require. Defaults to `managed`.

Shell.description: A predefined shell adapter used to run hook entries as shell source.
